schema_version: 1
mounts:
  student:
    prefix: /api/v1
    identity: trusted X-User-ID and X-User-Role headers
    allowed_roles: [STUDENT, STUDENT_PRO]
  admin:
    prefix: /admin/v1
    identity: trusted X-User-ID and X-User-Role headers
    allowed_roles: [REVIEWER, TEACHER, ADMIN]
  internal:
    prefix: /internal
    identity: X-Internal-Token shared secret
  public:
    prefix: /public/v1
    identity: none
student_route_groups:
  attempts:
    routes:
      - POST /student/tasks/{taskID}/start
      - POST /student/tasks/{taskID}/submit
      - POST /student/tasks/{taskID}/answers/{answerID}/submit
      - GET /student/tasks/{taskID}/answers
      - GET /student/tasks/{taskID}/answers/{answerID}
      - GET /student/answers/{answerID}
      - GET /student/results
      - GET /student/results/{answerID}
    start_response: answer_id and distinct learning_action_id plus existing runtime metadata
  course_access:
    routes:
      - GET /student/courses
      - GET /student/courses/{courseID}
      - GET /student/tasks/{taskID}
      - GET /student/tasks/{taskID}/access
      - GET /student/lessons/{lessonID}
      - GET /student/lessons/{lessonID}/access
      - GET /student/courses/{courseID}/progression
      - GET /student/course-versions/{courseID}/progression
    semantics: active public Course content or an exact non-archived assignment owned by the authenticated student
    task_response: recursively removes expected_answers from code_structure and structured answer-key fields
  preferences:
    - GET /student/positions
    - PUT /student/positions
  onboarding:
    routes:
      - GET /student/onboarding
      - PUT /student/onboarding
      - GET /student/onboarding/draft
      - PUT /student/onboarding/draft
      - POST /student/onboarding/draft/finalize
    semantics: declared direction, experience hypothesis, stacks, goal, language, time budget, and pace with optimistic expected_version
    draft_read: student-onboarding-draft.v1; absent storage is a stable DRAFT version 0; COMPLETED is a redacted tombstone and never returns answers
    draft_replace: strict full replacement with schema student-onboarding-draft.v1, expected_version, UUID Idempotency-Key, and a 16 KiB body cap; omitted/null is unanswered while explicit empty is validated as answered
    draft_finalize: strict student-onboarding-finalize.v1 with expected_draft_version, expected_profile_version, UUID Idempotency-Key, and a 1 KiB body cap; returns student-onboarding-finalize-result.v1
    atomicity: finalize updates existing student_onboarding, clears draft answers, records completion, and stores replay result together; same-key replay returns the original result without another profile version, while another key or every PUT after completion conflicts
    errors: malformed/schema/partial/incomplete 400; persisted draft absent at finalize 404; stale/completed/request-id reuse 409; storage failure 500
    identity: authenticated actor only; request bodies cannot select student_id
  learning_journey:
    routes:
      - GET /student/learning-path
      - GET /student/learning-paths
      - GET /student/learning-paths/{pathID}
      - GET /student/learning-paths/{pathID}/items/{itemID}/lesson-context
      - POST /student/learning-paths/{pathID}/activate
      - POST /student/learning-paths/{pathID}/pause
      - POST /student/learning-paths/{pathID}/resume
      - GET /student/learning-context
      - GET /student/diagnostics/latest
      - POST /student/learning-sessions
      - GET /student/learning-sessions
      - GET /student/learning-sessions/{sessionID}
      - PUT /student/learning-sessions/{sessionID}/end
  official_diagnostic_assessment:
    routes:
      - GET /student/diagnostic-assessments/current
      - GET /student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}
      - GET /student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/tasks/{taskID}
      - POST /student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/tasks/{taskID}/submit
      - POST /student/diagnostic-assessments/{attemptID}/complete
    semantics: placement-only immutable fixed-plan attempt; no ordinary answer, progression, learning action, evidence, mastery, Course completion, NATS, outbox, or Practice mutation
    freshness: current diagnostic identity select only an official immutable result/attempt whose onboarding_version equals the current student_onboarding.version; legacy snapshots never satisfy this condition
    task_read: owner-scoped frozen AUTO diagnostic task only, student-diagnostic-assessment-task.v1; explicit question/test/group/variant text IDs are allowlisted while expected answers, correctness, correct order, group/source keys, scorer data, runtime/compose/starter fields and redirects are excluded; missing/foreign/not-frozen are indistinguishable 404 and drift is 409
    privacy: attempt projections expose only safe frozen lesson/task/version/update/order/target references plus identities/counts and completed aggregate; never submitted/expected answers, correctness, scorer diagnostics, feedback, mastery, or path state
    commands: exact application/json, bounded strict JSON, UUID Idempotency-Key; same command replay is stable and conflicting reuse/second command is 409
  practice_runtime:
    prefix: /student/student-practice-tasks
    mode: legacy read-only compatibility by default; mutating routes return 410 Gone with owner ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator
    emergency_flag: LEGACY_PRACTICE_RUNTIME_WRITES_ENABLED=true temporarily restores old handlers
    read_operations: [list, get, list/get parts, lesson/task detail and access, roadmap, list final reviews, get portfolio publication]
    publication:
      routes:
        - PUT /student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/publication
        - GET /student/student-practice-tasks/{id}/publication
      visibility: [private, unlisted, public]
      eligibility: completed project plus passed mentor review with immutable artifact
      source: exact artifact referenced by the passed mentor review, never the live sandbox
  runtime_projection:
    - GET /runtime/tasks/{taskID}
    - GET /runtime/tasks/{taskID}/access
    - GET /runtime/lessons/{lessonID}
admin_routes:
  - POST /student/task/answers/{answerID}/review
legacy_practice_admin_routes:
  reads: ['GET /student/practice-task-reviews', 'GET /student/practice-tasks/{id}/final-reviews/{reviewID}']

internal_initial_learning_path_context_fence:
  route: PUT /students/{studentID}/learning-path
  optional_pair: expected_onboarding_version positive integer and expected_direction_code
  precondition: idempotent initial allocation with expected_version 0 and planning_request_id
  fresh_creation: transaction locks onboarding and validates version, direction_code, and goal_code before path insertion
  stale_context: 409 diagnostic_context_stale; no path side effects
  replay: exact committed receipt takes precedence over current onboarding context
  compatibility: absent optional fields preserve legacy allocation and request hash
internal_learning_action_context:
  lookup: exact student_id plus learning_action_id ownership pair
  response: action/task/context identity, frozen ordered learning targets, OPEN/CLOSED lifecycle status, and opened_at
  excludes: answer identity, objective outcome, evidence class, evidence rows, mastery, and reducer audit
  missing_or_foreign: 404 with no ownership distinction
  auth: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
internal_learning_action_code_context:
  lookup: exact student_id plus learning_action_id, then exact private answer binding to Sandbox
  response: availability plus at most 12 sorted text files, 16 KiB per file and 64 KiB total, truncation metadata, and the latest bounded Sandbox validation observation
  policy_version: student-learning-action-code-context-v1
  validation: sandbox-validation-observation-v1 carries only available, validation|tests kind, passed, issue_count, and checked_at; workspace mutation invalidates stale state
  excludes: answer and sandbox identities, secret files and lines, binary/dependency/build files, raw validator output, outcome, evidence, and mastery
  missing_sandbox: 200 with available false; an unavailable Sandbox dependency fails closed
  lifecycle: open learning actions only
  auth: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
internal_mastery_query:
  request: 1 to 100 unique exact concept/capability targets with key and optional version
  response: ordered current projections; missing targets are UNKNOWN with zero counters
  excludes: raw evidence and reducer audit history
  auth: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
internal_practice_evidence:
  route: POST /internal/students/{studentID}/practice-evidence
  request: practice-task-competency-evidence.v1
  response: student-practice-evidence-receipt.v1
  idempotency: canonical UUID Idempotency-Key equals evidence_id and submission_id; same digest replays, different digest conflicts
  validation: exact student ownership, passed outcome, 1 to 100 unique versioned targets, bounded Step IDs, metrics in [0,1], and consistent hint metadata
  commit: receipt, immutable target evidence, shared mastery projection, and Practice-specific reducer audit commit in one transaction
  auth: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
internal_practice_learning_actions:
  route: /internal/v2/students/{studentID}/practice-learning-actions/{taskInstanceID}
  auth: required dedicated PRACTICE_TASK_INTERNAL_TOKEN; it differs from general, Planner, and Teacher inbound tokens and general-token access is rejected
  reserve: PUT student-practice-learning-action-reserve.v1; UUID Idempotency-Key must equal taskInstanceID; optional learning_action_id is preserved when supplied and generated when omitted; normalizes URL identity plus immutable request body into an idempotent reservation
  binding: GET returns student-practice-learning-action-binding.v1 and hides foreign versus missing ownership with 404
  transitions: POST /open uses student-practice-learning-action-open.v1; POST /cancel uses student-practice-learning-action-cancel.v1 with practice_provisioning_failed only from RESERVED or student_cancelled from RESERVED/OPEN; POST /evidence uses practice-task-competency-evidence.v2 and returns student-practice-evidence-receipt.v2
  cancel: closes the binding as CANCELLED without evidence; same-reason replay is stable and a different reason after cancellation conflicts; the original immutable target/path reservation is retained
  evidence_v2: Idempotency-Key exactly equals canonical evidence_id/submission_id; body binds the Student-issued learning_action_id, URL student/instance, immutable revision ID/digest, lowercase workspace digest, passed outcome, bounded assistance facts, and exact ordered public target evidence. It accepts OPEN only, atomically writes a receipt correlated to the real action, folds shared mastery, closes the action, and completes the exact frozen IN_PROGRESS path item. Raw validation/code/snapshots/errors/private evaluation/fixtures/rubrics/solutions and legacy Course outbox emission are forbidden.
  validation: unknown/trailing JSON fails 400; bodies are capped at 32 KiB; revision/task/action IDs and Idempotency-Key are canonical lowercase UUIDs, digest is lowercase sha256, surface is practice|project, and targets are 1..100 unique versioned refs
  excludes: student_task_answer, Practice evaluation/result data, fixtures, solutions, raw evidence, mastery, and outbox events
internal_learner_overview:
  version: student-learner-overview-v2
  response: optional onboarding, at most 20 recent mastery projections, current path capped at 50 items, latest diagnostic capped at 100 targets, and five recent learning sessions
  excludes: raw evidence, reducer audit, answers, dialog history, prompts, and inferred diagnoses
  auth: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
  learning_path_identity: course_fingerprint is authoritative; curriculum_revision remains an equal compatibility alias
internal_planning_readiness:
  route: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/planning-readiness
  version: student-planning-readiness-snapshot.v1
  auth: exact X-Internal-Token shared secret
  read_consistency: one PostgreSQL repeatable-read read-only transaction; no receipt, outbox, idempotency, or state mutation
  precedence: active accepted draft (version >= 1) is authoritative; otherwise use finalized profile; missing state is state_ref kind=none version=0
  state_ref: kind is none|accepted_draft|finalized_profile; version is zero only for none and otherwise >=1
  arrays: known_stacks and desired_stacks carry state answered|unanswered|unresolved; values is present only for answered; known_stacks may be answered empty, while desired_stacks uses unanswered for the normal no-selection state and retains its existing non-empty answer validation
  learning_intent: emitted only for exact goal_code learn_programming as code=learn_programming source=onboarding_goal_code.v1 provenance=accepted_student_draft|finalized_profile; no alias, direction, or fuzzy inference
  language: preferred_language evidence is trusted only for matching accepted explicit_ui|explicit_text slot provenance; finalized profiles may retain earlier evidence only through the exact completed-draft/profile-version lineage; content_language is omitted unless that trusted evidence exists and then has source=preferred_language
  active_path: observational only and emitted only for the exact selected ACTIVE path; contains learning_path_id, version, course_id, goal_code, and status=ACTIVE
  excludes: raw model output, dialog/message content, onboarding writes, Course/path mutation, inferred/default language, raw evidence, and unbounded history
internal_learning_workspace:
  route: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-workspace
  version: student-learning-workspace.v1
  auth: dedicated exact TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN; general COURSE_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN is rejected
  feature_gate: STUDENT_LEARNING_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_ENABLED defaults false; disabled requests return 503 before a repository or database read
  read_consistency: one PostgreSQL repeatable-read read-only transaction; no receipt, outbox, idempotency, Course call, or state mutation
  response: context_version plus optional exact selected ACTIVE path with learning_path_id, course_id, ACTIVE status, path_version, and 1..500 ordered minimal item identities/statuses
  item_selection: consumers may deterministically choose the first IN_PROGRESS item, otherwise the first READY item; Student does not claim an item transition or lesson access from this response
  no_selected_path: selected_path is omitted; context_version is zero only when no context row exists
  excludes: student_id, targets, reason/rationale, curriculum revision, Course content, planning/admission/job IDs, evidence, receipts, dialog history, model/provider data, and mutations
  errors: invalid_student_id=400; disabled=503; inconsistent selected path/context=409; unavailable=500
internal_learning_journey:
  path: Learning Planner-only optimistic compatibility replacement with canonical Course fingerprint/revision plus Planner and Student storage policy versions
  new_path_allocation: optional planning_request_id plus UUID Idempotency-Key lets Student allocate one stable path ID transactionally; absent header falls back to planning_request_id
  no_gap_completion: dedicated-token optimistic command marks nonterminal items SKIPPED_MASTERED only when goal and fingerprint match; replay does not create a revision
  diagnostic: idempotent current-mastery snapshot; absent evidence is explicit UNKNOWN
  session_metrics: optimistic trusted aggregate update for active time, lessons, tasks, questions, selections, code runs, failures, passed tests, hints, interventions, and stuck signals; an identical replay is a no-op; wall-clock duration is never inferred as active learning
  auth: legacy path replacement/completion require dedicated LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN; diagnostics, session, and non-planning journey commands use the general internal token
internal_exact_path_planning:
  auth: all three routes require dedicated LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN; general internal token is rejected
  read: GET exact student_id/path_id returns student-learning-path-planning-state.v1 with path_version and whole journey_version
  replan: PUT exact path requires student-learning-path-replan.v1, UUID planning_request_id and Idempotency-Key, desired Course identity/fingerprint, expected current path version, Planner policy/reason, and 1..500 desired PLANNED/READY items; URL path plus version is the current precondition and the exact path identity/items are replaced atomically
  no_gap: PUT exact path completion requires student-learning-path-no-gap.v1, the same identities/version, no items, and mastery_no_gap reason
  response: student-learning-path-command-result.v1 with immutable planning_request_id, REPLAN|NO_GAP, changed flag, and resulting planning state
  reconciliation: keyed only by reference_type plus reference_id; matching READY/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/SKIPPED_MASTERED status, progress reason, and frozen targets do not regress or drift; target overlap without the same reference never carries progress to a new Course
  mutation: exact path only; a real mutation advances path_version and journey_version once, while semantic no-op and exact replay keep both stable
  errors: malformed or unknown JSON 400; invalid schema/fields 422; absent or foreign path 404; stale version, illegal status, or identity/hash reuse 409; unexpected storage error 500
internal_course_assignment:
  request: planning_request_id plus assigned_by=learning_planner and UUID Idempotency-Key
  semantics: idempotently creates or reuses one assignment for the exact student and Course; several different Courses may be active for one student
  auth: dedicated LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN; the general internal token is rejected
  commit_boundary: assignment and request receipt commit in one PostgreSQL transaction
internal_onboarding_path_admission:
  routes:
    - {method: POST, path: '/internal/students/{studentID}/onboarding-path-admissions', request: student-onboarding-path-admission-request.v1, response: student-onboarding-path-admission.v1, body_cap: 64 KiB}
    - {method: POST, path: '/internal/students/{studentID}/onboarding-path-admissions/{admissionID}/renewal', request: student-onboarding-path-admission-renewal.v1, response: student-onboarding-path-admission.v1, body_cap: 64 KiB}
    - {method: PUT, path: '/internal/students/{studentID}/onboarding-path-admissions/{admissionID}/materialization', request: student-onboarding-path-admission-materialization.v1, response: student-onboarding-path-materialization.v1, body_cap: 1 MiB}
    - {method: POST, path: '/internal/students/{studentID}/onboarding-path-admissions/{admissionID}/abort', request: student-onboarding-path-admission-abort.v1, response: student-onboarding-path-admission.v1, body_cap: 64 KiB}
  auth: dedicated LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN; feature flag STUDENT_ONBOARDING_PATH_ADMISSION_ENABLED defaults false
  wire: all route IDs and exactly one Idempotency-Key are lowercase hyphenated canonical UUIDs; JSON content type, unknown fields, trailing values, and oversize bodies are rejected
  idempotency: exact replay requires the same global receipt key, operation, student, and request hash; a new key never aliases an accepted handoff or terminal materialize/abort result
  fence: reserve, renew, materialize, abort, every ACTIVE/path/replan/no-gap writer, and every onboarding draft/profile state-ref writer serialize on one Student advisory fence before reading state
  materialization: under one transaction revalidates exact readiness state plus no ACTIVE path, then writes assignment, one selected primary ACTIVE path, first READY lesson, remaining PLANNED lessons, revision, context, terminal admission, and receipt
  errors: invalid_student_id=400 only for malformed studentID route parameter; invalid_request=422 for malformed admissionID, Idempotency-Key, or body; admission_not_found=404; state_changed, active_path_exists, reservation_expired, reservation_conflict, idempotency_conflict=409; disabled=503
internal_teacher_onboarding_turn_v2:
  routes:
    - {method: POST, path: '/internal/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns', request: student-onboarding-turn.v2, response: student-onboarding-turn-result.v2, body_cap: 16 KiB}
    - {method: GET, path: '/internal/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns/{studentCommandID}', response: student-onboarding-turn-result.v2}
    - {method: POST, path: '/internal/v1/teacher/students/{studentID}/onboarding/turns/{studentCommandID}/prove-no-effect', request: student-onboarding-turn-no-effect-proof.v2, response: student-onboarding-turn-result.v2, body_cap: 16 KiB}
  auth: dedicated non-empty TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN with exact constant-time comparison; an unset token leaves all routes unregistered
  feature_gate: TEACHER_ONBOARDING_TURN_V2_ENABLED defaults false; a new apply returns 503 without a committed effect while exact receipt replay, GET, and prove recovery remain available
  identity: URL studentID is injected by Student; apply requires Idempotency-Key equal to student_command_id, and prove requires its URL, header, and embedded command IDs to be equal canonical UUIDs
  command: student-onboarding-turn.v2 is a bounded 1..9-slot typed command with dialog, Teacher, message, source, causal, and expected-version identities; action and text evidence are mutually exclusive
  effects: Student atomically writes either immutable accepted draft/profile effect plus provenance, or immutable no_effect receipt/proof; an unknown GET is 404 and never evidence of no effect
  excludes: public/browser callers, raw LLM output, message bodies, assistant UI payloads, profile-shaped writes, Dialog/AI Prompt/Planner calls, and S6-or-later orchestration

public_publication_contract:
  share_link: ready unlisted or public publication with a 192-bit opaque slug
  profile_listing: ready public publications only
  response: immutable task/result metadata, safe source manifest, and text source files for a share link
  forbidden: student live sandbox IDs, file-storage IDs, terminals, writes, runtime execution, preview URLs, private evaluation data, security exclusion paths, AI prompt, mentor rubric
  cache_control: no-store so a private visibility change revokes later reads

next_best_action:
  owner: ms-go-student
  schema: student-next-action.v1
  policy_version: student-next-action-policy.v1
  public_route: GET /api/v1/student/next-action
  teacher_route: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/next-action
  teacher_auth: dedicated TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN; general and Planner tokens rejected
  cache_control: no-store
  semantics: derived read-only decision; no receipt, mutation, materialization, submission, lesson completion, or replanning
  response:
    status: READY | WAITING | PLANNING_REQUIRED | NO_PROGRESSION
    primary: exactly one kind/target for READY; omitted otherwise
    secondary_actions: array of permitted kind/target alternatives; never co-primary
    reason_code: deterministic machine-readable reason
    source_versions: context_version, path_version, optional runtime_version, state_digest
  execution: snapshot is not a capability; command owner revalidates current invariants

assigned_lesson_context:
  public: GET /api/v1/student/learning-paths/{pathID}/items/{itemID}/lesson-context
  private: GET /internal/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/items/{itemID}/lesson-context
  identity: public trusted actor STUDENT/STUDENT_PRO; private existing shared X-Internal-Token read credential
  schema: student-assigned-lesson-context.v1
  fields: [schema, student_id, learning_path_id, learning_path_item_id, course_id, lesson_id, lesson_revision_id, content_digest, content]
  content_fields: [title, excerpt, description]
  digest: 'sha256:lowercase64 of Go encoding/json.Marshal([3]string{exact title, excerpt, description})'
  bounds: UTF-8 title1000runes excerpt4000runes description1MiBbytes final_marshaled_response2MiBbytes
  read: exact owned GetLearningPathByID and unique item; no lifecycle command guard or Course lookup
  errors: missing/foreign404 ambiguous409 malformed_or_missing_frozen400 unavailable_storage500 unconfigured503
  cache_control: no-store
  excludes: tasks, answers, translations, mutable content, provider bodies

internal_planning_snapshot:
  route: POST /internal/v1/students/{studentID}/learning-paths/{pathID}/planning-snapshot
  auth: existing dedicated LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN only; absent token leaves the route unregistered; general, Teacher, Practice, unknown and missing tokens are rejected
  schema: student-planning-snapshot.v1
  request:
    fields: [targets, trigger_context]
    targets: 1..500 normalized exact unique concept/capability refs; existing key 255 bytes and optional version 128 bytes; empty version remains an exact legacy identity and is never inferred
    trigger_context: required nonblank UTF-8 kind and reason, optional canonical UUID correlation_id; caller trace only, never authoritative trigger/category/permission
    strictness: application/json, canonical nonzero URL UUIDs, exact field names, duplicate JSON keys, nulls, unknown fields and trailing values rejected before owner read
    body_cap_bytes: 2097152
  read_consistency: one repeatable-read read-only PostgreSQL transaction for exact owned path, current context/profile, requested mastery, safe evidence references, frozen requirements/facts and Student-known Course/Practice bindings; zero writes/receipts and no sibling HTTP calls
  response_fields: [schema, student_id, learning_path_id, captured_at, trigger_context, references, requested_targets, profile, path, mastery, evidence, activity_facts, course_bindings, practice_bindings, availability, optional_pending_intent]
  references: deterministic SHA-256 content addresses for learner, mastery, goal, constraints and complete snapshot; requested target set and all relevant local protected references are bound; captured_at and caller trace are excluded
  versions: existing coarse profile owner_version anchors goal/constraints, and existing path_version/journey_version anchor local state; no newly persisted monotonic planning/mastery/goal counters
  protected_state: ordered item identities/statuses, exact lesson revisions, frozen requirements/satisfaction, activity fact references and exact Student-known action/TaskInstance associations are retained

  unavailable: runtime_hold, automatic_adaptation and student_pinning carry UNAVAILABLE/null; V1 permits only exact same-goal future AUTO operations and never infers Runtime hold or learner intent
  response_cap_bytes: 134217728
  oversize: technical whole-response bound fails closed without silent truncation or smaller per-item semantic caps
